name: CHEG 4143W
title: Chemical Engineering Capstone Design II
description: Continuation of work on chemical process and simulation projects assigned in CHEG 4140. Group work, written and oral communication, and presentation of the final project, which analyzes a chemical process from technical, economic, safety, and environmental perspectives.
requirement_description: CHEG 4140 and 4142; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher; open only to Chemical Engineering majors.
